title: AliasTable
description: What each KC id of a course became (courses/<id>/aliases.yaml; docs/migration-design.md): the table `upgrade` reads to turn an event of the old shape into the new one. Written by the converter, never by hand.

Alias.title: Alias
Alias.description: One old id. Where the event names its sentence, `byItem` says exactly which parts the id stood for there (tuvo: the lexeme and its stem); elsewhere `part`, never more than the old id can vouch for.

part.description: What the id becomes where the sentence is not known. Absent for an id that became nothing a learner has (a form KC that is now a token's feature values).

byItem.description: By sentence or story line id: the parts the id stood for in it.
